title: Two Endings, One Tense: -ra and -se
goal: See that -ra and -se mean the same, and know that -ra is by far the commoner in Latin America.
grammar: Using -ra and -se: same meaning, different frequency

items: I can tell that -ra and -se are two forms of the same tense with the same meaning.
I can use -ra when I speak and recognise -se when I read.
I can use the new words for newspapers and the law.
